theater: 高麗北部龜州與義州邊境

battle.name: 第一次高麗契丹戰爭
battle.theater: 高麗北部龜州與義州邊境
battle.brief: 993年秋，遼聖宗以高麗拒納歲幣、接濟北漢又與宋結盟為由，發大軍越鴨綠江攻龜州、義州邊城。高麗成宗拒絕和議，徵二軍六衛與諸道兵禦敵，以弓弩據城，遣使宋廷求援，遼軍終以遠師疲敝退兵。卡面埃及月牙劍為外彎單刃砍刀，同高麗環首刀、遼軍契丹彎刀同類，借它標示冷兵器接戰的形制邏輯。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 交戰的兩方是東北的契丹遼與半島上的高麗。遼方以耶律氏的契丹本部為骨幹，由聖宗耶律隆緒統軍，其時蕭綽執掌朝政，遠征決策出自南面官署與北面官署的會商；遠征軍並非單純的部族騎兵，而是契丹騎兵、漢人漢軍、渤海兵與各部族丁壯的合編，北面官籍的勳貴多居統率之位，南面漢軍多擔任攻城與器械之役。共治天下的格局也反映在兵制上：契丹人自備數匹戰馬，漢人、渤海人則以步兵、匠役與搬運攻城之具為主。高麗方的最高統帥是國王成宗王弘，首都松京的決策由中書門下與執政官、六部同議，軍力則以二軍六衛的中央常備軍和諸道州縣的州郡兵組成，另有御林軍擔任宿衛與預備。此外還有第三方：北方的宋，與被遼所平的北漢、被宋所滅的後蜀，都站在高麗這一側的因果鏈上。宋在993年同高麗訂立攻遼之約，北漢與後蜀則是高麗先前援助的對象，三者的關係把一次邊境衝突推成了區域體系之間的對抗。
countriesEn: The two sides in this conflict were the Khitan Liao in the northeast and the state of Goryeo on the Korean peninsula. On the Liao side the backbone was the Khitan proper under the house of Yelü, the army commanded by the emperor Shengzong, Yelü Longxu, while the empress dowager Xiao directed the government and the decision to invade was taken jointly by the southern and the northern administrations; the expeditionary force was not a tribal cavalry host alone but a mixed levy of Khitan horsemen, Han Chinese units, Bohai soldiers and the warriors of the subject tribes, with the meritorious nobles registered in the northern administration usually holding the command and the southern Han formations being put to the assault of walls and the handling of engines. The dual structure of the empire showed in its armament too: Khitan men carried several warhorses each, while Han and Bohai men served mainly as infantry, craftsmen and the haulers of siege equipment. On the Goryeo side the supreme commander was the king, Seongjong, whose personal name was Wang Hong, and at the capital of Songgyung the decisions were taken by the Secretariat, the senior ministers, the six ministries and the commandants of the armies in common; the military resources were the standing central force of the two armies and six guards, together with the provincial and county levies of the circuits, while the royal guard, the yurim, was responsible for palace protection and for the strategic reserve. Two further parties belong in the picture: to the north the Song, and the Northern Han and the Later Shu, which had been put down by the Liao and by the Song respectively, all sat on the causal chain behind Goryeo's side. In 993 the Song concluded with Goryeo an agreement to attack the Liao together, and Northern Han and Later Shu were the states Goryeo had earlier assisted; it was these relationships that turned a frontier clash into a confrontation between regional systems.
people: 這場戰爭裡真正推動決策的是三個人與一批軍將。高麗成宗王弘在989至1013年之間在位，登位時年紀尚輕；遼聖宗耶律隆緒在982至1031年之間在位，那時蕭綽主政，把南進列為國策。成宗面對遼使索求歲幣時，沒有像前代那樣照例奉上，反而在993年正式遣使出使宋廷，一般認為由宰相崔文本領隊，議定宋麗共同對遼的默契，這一外交動作是遼軍此年大舉東來的直接刺激之一。蕭綽與聖宗是把收復燕雲、迫高麗就範寫進既定政策的一對，主導了此後數次對半島用兵。軍將方面，高麗一方在這場戰爭及其後的再犯中浮現了崔仁、柳萬、尹瓊等人：崔仁以鎮守西北、臨機設伏見長，柳萬以統馭騎兵、奔走外交著稱，尹瓊則因弩兵破遼軍鐵人重甲騎的戰例而留名。遼方的統帥多出自蕭氏與耶律氏的北面勳貴，蕭排押與韓吃貪在1011年再入高麗時明確擔任主將，耶律休哥則是整個世紀遼軍南下的名將，直到十一世紀末，北方線的攻守幾乎都留有他的痕跡。
peopleEn: The men who really drove the decisions in this war were three individuals and a body of generals. King Seongjong of Goryeo, Wang Hong, reigned from 989 to 1013 and was still young when he took the throne; the Liao emperor Shengzong, Yelü Longxu, reigned from 982 to 1031, and in those years the empress dowager Xiao held the government and made a southern advance part of the state's settled policy. Confronted with Liao envoys demanding the annual tribute, Seongjong did not pay it over as his predecessors had done, and instead in 993 he dispatched a formal embassy to the Song court, generally thought to have been led by the chancellor Choe Munmun, and there the Song and Goryeo worked out the understanding by which they would together press the Liao; that diplomatic step was one of the direct provocations for the great Liao drive eastward in that year. The empress dowager Xiao and Shengzong were the pair who wrote the recovery of the Yanyun and the subjection of Goryeo into settled policy, and they directed the repeated use of the peninsula afterwards. On the military side Goryeo's commanders who came to the fore in this war and in the later invasions were Choe Im, Ryu Man and Yun Gyeong: Choe Im for his defence of the northwest and his ambushes, Ryu Man for his command of cavalry and his diplomatic missions, and Yun Gyeong for the exploit in which his crossbowmen broke the Liao's armoured iron cavalry. The Liao command came chiefly from the meritorious nobles of the Xiao and Yelü clans in the northern administration: Xiao Paiya and Han Chi-tan are named as the commanders of the renewed invasion of 1011, and Yelü Xiuge was the famous general of Liao campaigns to the south throughout the century, and until the end of the eleventh century the operations on the northern line bore his mark almost everywhere.
kits: 卡面兵器是埃及月牙劍，一種外彎的單刃短刀，弧形刀身向前伸出，砍下去不必像直劍那樣拔出，刃根處有凸出的護手，通常配小圓盾使用，形制最早可溯到埃及早王朝那種扁平戰斧，銅質之後改為鐵質，在新王國時期是軍人近身搏鬥的標準配備。它當然不存在於993年的朝鮮半島，中東的月牙劍與東北亞的環首刀之間沒有任何技術往來，但它精確標示出這場戰爭中冷兵器交鋒的基本邏輯：以單刃的弧形去劈砍、切割，放棄以刺擊取勝，靠力與速度而不是靠精確的打點。高麗軍隊的配備以弓弩為主，環首刀、劍、骨朵、錘、斧為輔，鎧甲以札甲與鎖子甲為主，配兜鍪、臂韝與牌盾，弩箭與弓矢分層儲備，弩兵在高麗是獨立的兵種，遠射距離與穿甲力是其倚重所在。遼軍以契丹式彎刀、狼牙棒與骨朵為近戰兵器，弓矢與重甲騎兵並行，鎧甲兼用皮甲與鐵甲，另有數量不多的重甲騎兵鐵人。攻城方面，遼軍攜帶車砲、撞車、雲梯與火箭，砲手多出自南面漢軍，火藥兵器在十一世紀初的宋境戰役中已有記錄。雙方真正的差距在馬匹：契丹依控弦之制每名騎手備數匹馬，高麗本土良馬不足，北上用馬多賴北方輸入，這一弱點在持久戰中屢次顯現。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Egyptian khopesh, a short single-edged sword with an outward-curving blade that reaches forward, so that a blow can be delivered without the blade having to be pulled back in the manner of a straight sword; it has a pronounced guard at the root of the blade and was normally used with a small round shield. Its form can be traced back to the flat battle-axe of the early Egyptian dynasties; after copper it was made in iron, and in the New Kingdom period it was standard kit for close fighting by the soldier. It was of course absent from the Korean peninsula in 993: there was no technical contact whatever between the Middle Eastern khopesh and the Northeast Asian ring-pommel sword. Yet it marks exactly the basic logic of cold-steel combat in this war: to cleave and cut with a single-edged curve, abandoning the point, winning by strength and speed rather than by precision of the thrust. The Goryeo army was armed chiefly with bows and crossbows, with ring-pommel swords, double-edged swords, maces, hammers and axes as auxiliaries; its armour was chiefly plated and mail, with helmets, arm-guards and small shields, and its bolts and arrows were stored by grade. The crossbowmen formed a distinct arm of the Goryeo army, and the reach and the piercing power of the weapon were what they relied on. The Liao army used Khitan-style sabres, wolf-toothed clubs and maces in close combat, combining bows with armoured cavalry, wearing both leather and iron armour, and there was a small body of heavily armoured horsemen, the iron cavalry. For the attack they brought wheeled bombards, battering rams, scaling ladders and fire-arrows; the artillery crews were mostly Han Chinese from the southern administration, and gunpowder weapons are already recorded in the Liao's campaigns in Song territory in the early eleventh century. The real difference between the two sides lay in horses: under the Khitan system of several mounts per rider every horseman kept several warhorses, whereas Goryeo's own stock of fine horses was short, and the horses needed for northern operations came largely from imports out of the north, a weakness that showed itself repeatedly in a long war.
tactics: 遼軍的戰法以秋冬季的長距離騎兵突進為骨架：先以輕騎越鴨綠江，掠取沿邊郡縣與屯田，聚滅高麗分散的烽燧與邊寨，再以重甲騎兵與步卒跟進，把奪下的堡寨改成前進的支點，同時派車砲與撞車攻擊城壁，投擲火藥與火箭破壞守軍的抵抗，最後以分割的縱隊深入，目標不是攻下每座城，而是切斷松京與北方郡縣的糧道、動搖邊民的遷徙。高麗的應對反其道而行：不追求在野外交鋒，而是把兵分據城壁與山隘，以弩箭的連續射擊遲滯騎兵衝鋒，待敵分散才以二軍六衛的精兵出擊殲滅；同時以烽火連鎖傳警、以屯田維持邊軍給養、以使臣赴宋廷求援以牽制遼軍的西路。993年之後高麗把防禦重心移向北境，先後在979至1031年間分五期修築城壁，形成內外兩線，重要州縣一律築城，軍戶與民戶分屯，邊防由逐寇轉為守城。往後的戰例把這套邏輯寫得清楚：1011年遼軍再犯時高麗避其鋒、待其深入，於存在一帶以弩兵破其重甲騎；1018年遼軍遠襲至慶州，縱深已達數百里，高麗集中兵力反擊，把遼軍逐出北方，退兵之際的追擊與斷糧，成為雙方勝負的關鍵。
tacticsEn: The Liao method of war was built around a long cavalry thrust in the autumn and winter. Light horsemen would cross the Yalu, ravage the border districts and the state farms, and extinguish the scattered beacon towers and frontier stockades of Goryeo; armoured cavalry and foot followed, converting the forts they had taken into stepping-stones for the next advance, while wheeled bombards and battering rams were brought up against the walls and gunpowder and fire-arrows were thrown against the defenders. The final advance was made in divided columns, and the object was not to take every city but to cut the supply road from Songgyung to the northern districts and to unsettle the population of the border. Goryeo answered in the opposite manner: it did not seek a meeting in the open field, but distributed its troops among the walls and the defiles, used the continuous shooting of the crossbow to slow the charge of the horsemen, and only counter-attacked with the picked troops of the two armies and six guards once the enemy had been drawn apart. Alongside this it used a chain of beacons to carry the alarm, used state farms to feed the frontier army, and sent envoys to the Song court so as to tie down the Liao on its western flank. After 993 Goryeo moved the weight of its defence northward, building walls in five successive stages between 979 and 1031 until there were an inner and an outer line; the important districts were walled, military households and civilian households were settled in separate garrisons, and the frontier changed from a war of pursuit into a war of the wall. Later cases set the logic out plainly. When the Liao returned in 1011, Goryeo gave ground, let the enemy drive deep, and broke the armoured cavalry of the Liao with the crossbowmen around the district of Junson; in 1018 the Liao army struck as far as Kyongju, a penetration of several hundred li, and Goryeo concentrated its strength and counter-attacked, driving the Liao back out of the north, where the pursuit and the cutting of the road during the withdrawal decided the issue.
data: 可據的年表如下：993年為高麗成宗四年，遼軍在秋令越境而入，先攻北邊的龜州與義州一帶。雙方往後的衝突節點是1011年、1014年、1015至1016年、1018年與1029年，其中1011與1014仍屬第一場戰爭的延續，1018年遼軍深入至慶州一線，1029年一度逼近首都圈的城壁。遼軍的兵數在《三國史記》與《遼史》之間差距極大，有號百萬之說，也有記作十萬、二十萬者；比較可靠的判斷是投入的契丹本部騎兵在數萬量級，加上漢軍、渤海兵與被徵發的丁壯，總數當在十萬上下，其中真正能作戰的騎兵遠少於此。高麗方面的兵源是二軍六衛的中央常備軍、御林軍宿衛與諸道州縣的州郡兵，總數不宜按後世編纂的兵籍額度回推，因為戰時大量郡兵只是臨時集結。地理上，龜州一般認為在今平安南道與黃海道交界的山區，義州在今平安南道義州郡、鴨綠江下游北岸，兩地相距約二百餘里；松京在今開城一帶，距義州約四百餘里。這就是遼軍每次進攻必取龜州、義州的原因：占住此二州，才能打通由鴨綠江到松京的通道。
dataEn: The chronology that can be relied on runs as follows. The year 993 was the fourth year of Seongjong of Goryeo; the Liao army crossed the border in the autumn and struck first at Kwijŏ and the district of Uiju to the north. The later nodes of conflict were 1011, 1014, 1015 to 1016, 1018 and 1029, of which 1011 and 1014 still belong to the continuation of this first war, in 1018 the Liao army penetrated as far as Kyongju, and in 1029 it came close to the walls around the capital. The numbers of the Liao army differ enormously between the Samguk Sagi and the Liao Shi, ranging from a claimed million to figures of a hundred thousand and two hundred thousand; the sounder judgement is that the Khitan cavalry committed numbered in the tens of thousands, and that with Han troops, Bohai men and conscripted labour the total was of the order of a hundred thousand, of whom the number who could actually fight on horseback was far smaller. On the Goryeo side the manpower was the standing central force of the two armies and six guards, the palace guard, and the district levies of the circuits and counties; the total should not be reconstructed backwards from the quotas of the later compiled muster rolls, because at the time a great many district troops were only hastily assembled. Geographically, Kwijŏ is generally placed in the mountains where the present Pyongan-namdo and Hwanghae-do meet, and Uiju lies in present Uiju-gun of Pyongan-namdo on the north bank of the lower Yalu, the two being some two hundred li apart; Songgyung is in the neighbourhood of modern Kaesong, some four hundred li from Uiju. This is why the Liao took Kwijŏ and Uiju on every advance: holding those two districts was what opened the road from the Yalu to Songgyung.
cause: 導火線有三層。最外層是歲幣：十世紀中葉以後高麗曾按例向遼奉送歲幣，到成宗朝改為拒納，遼使屢次到高麗索求不果，雙方在名分上的摩擦愈演愈烈。第二層是援助北敵：高麗與被宋所滅的後蜀、被遼所平的北漢都有往來，《宋史》記高麗曾以海道向北漢輸糧，此舉在遼的戰略眼光裡就是把物資送到前線的敵人。第三層是宋麗結盟：993年高麗正式遣使到宋廷，一般認為由宰相崔文本領隊，宋廷厚酬來使並授予高麗君臣官爵，兩國約定夾擊遼朝，交換條件之一是宋願在高麗收復後蜀故地時予以考慮。遼廷視之為對南面秩序的挑戰，加上此時蕭綽主政、聖宗年少而好大功，遂以大軍東來作為答覆。此外，邊境上的叛逃者與俘虜往來、遼方要求高麗交還逃人，以及雙方對山前草場與遊牧部族的爭奪，都是長期累積的摩擦點，只等一個藉口便同時爆發。
causeEn: The immediate causes lie on three levels. The outermost is the annual tribute: in the middle of the tenth century Goryeo had duly sent tribute to the Liao, but under Seongjong the practice was refused, the Liao envoys who came repeatedly to demand it went away empty-handed, and the friction over forms of address and precedence between the two grew steadily worse. The second level is aid to the enemy in the north: Goryeo had dealings both with the Later Shu, destroyed by the Song, and with the Northern Han, put down by the Liao but still hoping to recover its state, and the Song Shi records that Goryeo carried grain north to Northern Han by sea; in Liao strategic eyes this was the handing of supplies to an enemy on the front. The third level is the Goryeo-Song alliance: in 993 Goryeo sent a formal embassy to the Song court, generally thought to have been led by the chancellor Choe Munmun, the Song court made rich return to the envoys and conferred ranks on Goryeo's king and his ministers, and the two states agreed to press the Liao from two directions, one of the terms of the understanding being that the Song would consider Goryeo's recovery of the old Later Shu lands. The Liao court read this as a challenge to the southern order it maintained; and since the empress dowager Xiao then held the government and the young Shengzong was given to great projects, the answer was a great army to the east. On top of these, the movement of rebels and prisoners across the frontier, the Liao's demand that Goryeo hand back those who had fled, and the two sides' quarrel over the grazing grounds in the hills and over the nomadic clans there were friction points accumulated over a long time, waiting only for one pretext to make them break out together.
impact: 993年之後的三十餘年裡，高麗與遼又打了三場大規模戰爭，加上993年這一場，合計四次。第一次戰爭的實際結果不是誰滅了誰，而是雙方都確認了一件事：遼可以反覆打到高麗的腹地，高麗卻沒有能力追到遼的本土。於是高麗把國策改為兩條腿走路，一面修城壁、實屯田、練弩兵，把北部邊防從流動的逐寇戰改成固定的守城戰；一面加深同宋的往來，用宋的介入來分擔遼的壓力，1019年前後宋麗聯手迫遼議和，1029年之後雙方恢復使節往來，高麗重新回到向遼送歲幣的舊規。這一連串變化的代價不小：北方軍鎮長期屯紮，糧餉由都城與南部州縣輸送，錢與布帛大量流往邊地，民間應徵的搶丁與負擔都隨之加重。技術面上也有實績：高麗在這一輪戰爭中把弩兵獨立成軍，大弩與神臂弓成為邊防主力；遼軍則把車砲與火藥兵器帶到半島，攻城不再只靠撞擊，牆頭的守軍第一次要面對飛越城頭的投射物。長期戰爭還改變了高麗軍制的重心，御林軍與二軍六衛的編制被反覆整頓，北方防禦所需的騎兵與馬政，成為此後百餘年高麗最費心力的課題之一。
impactEn: In the thirty-odd years after 993 the Liao fought Goryeo in three further large wars, four in all together with this one. The real outcome of the first war was not that either side destroyed the other, but that both discovered the same thing: the Liao could strike again and again deep into the heartland of Goryeo, while Goryeo had no capacity to follow the Liao onto its own soil. Goryeo accordingly put its policy on two legs. On the one hand it built walls, established state farms and trained crossbowmen, converting the northern frontier from a fluid war of pursuit into a fixed war of the wall; on the other it deepened its relations with the Song, using Song intervention to share the weight of Liao pressure, and around 1019 the Song and Goryeo together forced the Liao to treat, so that after 1029 envoys passed again and Goryeo returned to the old custom of sending tribute to the Liao. The price of all this was not small: the northern garrisons stayed in the field for years, their grain and provisions had to be carried from the capital and the southern districts, money and cloth flowed to the frontier in bulk, and the levying of men and the burden on the countryside grew with it. There were practical results on the technical side as well. In this round of fighting Goryeo made the crossbowmen an independent arm, and the heavy crossbow and the divine-arm bow became the mainstay of the frontier defence; the Liao carried wheeled bombards and gunpowder weapons onto the peninsula, so that siege was no longer a matter of battering alone, and the defenders on the wall for the first time had to face projectiles flying over the parapet. Protracted war also shifted the balance of the Goryeo military system: the royal guard and the two armies and six guards were reorganized again and again, and the cavalry and the horse system required by the northern defence became one of the most expensive preoccupations of Goryeo for the following century and more.
result: 就993年這一場而言，勝負很清楚：高麗沒有失掉城池，遼軍在攻掠邊境、破壞屯田之後退回，雙方回到戰前的分界線上。但和平只是暫時的，高麗既未恢復歲幣，也未取得遼廷的讓步，遠征的隊伍在1011年、1014年再度出現，而且一次比一次深入；1018年遼軍推進到慶州，說明高麗的城壁線在初期仍嫌太疏，直到1020年代完成五期城壁的興建，北方防禦才真正站穩。整個第一場戰爭到1015年才算收束，之後高麗又經歷1015至1016年、1018年、1029年三場戰事，才換來一段相對安寧的歲月，並把北方的國防永久地改寫成城壁與屯田的樣子。對兵器史而言，這一輪衝突留下兩條線索：一是單刃的劈砍型冷兵器在中東北亞的戰場上仍是近戰的骨幹，從高麗的環首刀到遼的契丹式彎刀，再到後來更擅長斬擊的刀型，演變的起點都在此；二是投射火力在守城中的分量，弩兵與車砲、火藥兵器在城牆上的角力，替後來高麗對宋、對蒙古的防禦定下了基本格式。戰爭沒有改變半島與東北亞權力對比的大勢，卻讓高麗學會了以城與弩拖延遠征者的辦法，並讓契丹人明白：若要滅一個國家，遠征半島的代價遠高於它在燕雲所收穫的。
resultEn: As for the year 993 itself the outcome is plain: Goryeo lost no city, the Liao army withdrew after ravaging the frontier and breaking up the state farms, and the two sides came back to the line they had held before the war. But the peace was only a pause. Goryeo had neither restored the tribute nor obtained any concession from the Liao court, and the columns of invasion reappeared in 1011 and 1014, each time penetrating further than the last; when the Liao army reached Kyongju in 1018 it showed that the Goryeo line of walls was still too thin in its early stages, and the northern defence only stood firm once the five stages of wall-building were completed in the 1020s. The first war was not closed out until 1015, and Goryeo had still to pass through the wars of 1015 to 1016, of 1018 and of 1029 before it bought a stretch of comparative quiet, and before the defence of its north was permanently rewritten in the shape of walls and state farms. For the history of weapons this round of conflict left two threads. First, the single-edged cleaving blade remained the backbone of close combat on the battlefields of the Middle East and Northeast Asia, from the Goryeo ring-pommel sword to the Khitan-style saber of the Liao and on to the later blade types better suited to cutting strokes, and the line of development starts here. Second, there was the weight of missile fire in the defence of walls: the duel between crossbowmen on one side and bombards and gunpowder weapons on the other set the basic pattern for Goryeo's later defence against the Song and against the Mongols. The war did not alter the balance of power between the peninsula and Northeast Asia, but it taught Goryeo how to use walls and crossbows to hold up a distant invader, and it taught the Khitan that to destroy a state outright, the price of campaigning into the peninsula was far higher than what they gathered in the Yanyun.
